speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To begin our assessment, what is your baby's age in hours or days, and was the jaundice present at birth or did it develop later?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiological Jaundice of the Second Week). The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with weight gain and late-onset jaundice is consistent with this diagnosis; no further immediate tests are required unless bilirubin levels are dangerously high.
